description: Sales operations environment for SLA response-time monitoring across customer accounts. Scheduling data from the meeting platform, Salesforce account records, and an 'Account Tiers' SLA-targets spreadsheet are available for read and analysis. sla_policy_manual.content: Customer Success SLA Policy v3.1. Breach defined as first-response or resolution exceeding tier target. 'At-risk' = elapsed time has reached 75% of the SLA target without a logged response. Platinum breaches require same-day escalation; Gold/Silver next-business-day; Bronze weekly review. Escalations and customer-facing communications require the account owner's sign-off before dispatch.

tools.description: Compare actual response times against tier SLA targets to classify each account as compliant, at-risk, or breaching.
